nodes.name: F-modification of CoP
nodes.procedure: As-prepared CoP anchored on CFP was annealed under argon atmosphere with NH4F, which decomposes into HF species. In a typical synthesis for CoP|F-20, 4 pieces of CFP decorated with CoP were put into a porcelain boat in the furnace. 20 mg of NH4F powders were put in another porcelain boat at the upstream side. The furnace was heated to 400°C with a rate of 10°C/min, kept at 400°C for 2 h under Ar atmosphere, then cooled naturally to ambient temperature.

nodes.characterization_summary: Co K-edge XANES of CoP|F-20 shows higher white line energy than CoP, confirming electron transfer to F; ex situ Co valance states 1.86 for CoP|F-20 vs 1.69 for CoP.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Co K-edge X-ray absorption near-edge structure (XANES) spectra in Figure 1k. The white line value at ≈7722 eV for CoP matches well with the literature value, while K-edge energies of Co for CoP|F-20 also slightly shift to upper absorption energy.

nodes.characterization_summary: Co K-edge EXAFS shows Co-P peaks at 1.62 Å for CoP|F-20 and 1.64 Å for CoP, demonstrating lattice compression by F modification.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Fourier transform (FT) Co K-edge extended X-ray absorption fine structure (EXAFS) analysis (Figure 1l), CoP|F-20 and CoP possess peaks at 1.62 and 1.64 Å respectively, which could be assigned to Co-P coordinates.

properties.description: Extended X-ray Absorption Fine Structure, Fourier transform, normalized

nodes.characterization_summary: Operando Co K-edge XANES at 30 mA cm⁻² shows Co oxidation state reduction to 0.15 for CoP|F-20 (near Co foil) vs 0.87 for CoP; EXAFS shows complete disappearance of Co-P peak (1.64 Å) with emergence of Co-Co (2.12 Å, CN 8.4) and Co-F (CN 0.6) in CoP|F-20 vs partial Co-P reduction in CoP.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Evidently, under working conditions (30 mA cm⁻² in 0.5 M H₂SO₄), the peak at 1.64 Å, assigned to Co-P coordinate, disappears with the emergence of a new peak at 2.12 Å.

nodes.characterization_summary: Operando Raman shows no photon scattering in 300-400 cm⁻¹ region, confirming amorphous nature of CoP|F-20 and CoP under HER conditions.
nodes.evidence_snippet: No photon scattering observed in the 300 - 400 cm⁻¹ spectral region suggests the amorphous nature of both CoP|F-20 and CoP samples under working conditions.

nodes.characterization_summary: EIS shows charge transfer resistance R_ct of 6 Ω for CoP|F-20 vs 17 Ω for CoP.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The charge transfer resistance (R_ct) of CoP|F-20 is merely 6 Ohm, compared with ≈17 Ohm of CoP.

nodes.characterization_summary: CV double-layer capacitance C_dl of CoP|F-20 is 1.7 times higher than CoP.
nodes.evidence_snippet: C_dl value of CoP|F-20 sample is 1.7 times higher than that of CoP sample.
